basic_info.description: Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac on iconic Nob Hill, this rare two level 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence offers the perfect blend of contemporary finishes and timeless San Francisco sophistication. One of only two units in a handsome 2001 building, this spacious condominium lives like a private home, complete with elevator access opening directly to both floors. Recently remodeled, the home now showcases rich hardwood flooring and recessed lighting throughout, elevating both comfort and style. The layout is ideal for entertaining, with an elegant, bright living room with gas fireplace, plus a great room with seamless flow into a chef's kitchen equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, including a Wolf gas range, Sub-Zero refrigerator and new quartz countertops. A refreshed powder room rounds out the main level. The private lower-level features three spacious bedrooms with generous closets, including a primary bedroom with dual closets, an ensuite remodeled marbled bath with heated flooring and a walk-out patio. An additional updated hall bath, plus both linen & laundry closets add to the house-like feel. Further highlights include one car side-by-side parking with EV charging, extra storage, and a quintessentially charming & central San Francisco location; 100 walk & rider scores!
